claims.mechanism: The #1 candidate is blocked on naming where the CORRECTED buyer class gathers. state/portfolio.json the_priced_artifact.who_it_actually_addresses records that task .k asked about developers buying source code, while the product description addresses shops, cafes, salons, streamers and campaign pages. .k's questions 1 and 4 are therefore aimed off-target and its venue answer is for the wrong crowd. This lap re-asks the venue and rule questions against the class the description actually names. It cannot itself make the ETA finite, so it is claimed as a prerequisite: it produces the venue+rule evidence that a direct route claim would have to rest on. Cost falls on the ChatGPT pool, not the weekly quota.
